text_block_list.text: One day at lunchtime, in the academy cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum~♪ It's finally—
It's finally here! Salad bar day!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes☆ I've been waiting for this day with bated breath from 1,000 miles away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna pile it on
huuuge and suuuuper generous~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—More haste, less speed♪ Around the rim of the plate♪
Let's line it up♪ Big leaves of lettuce~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Next is a carrot, then another carrot♪
Tomatoes, asparagus, and onions too~♪

The salad plated by Gran Alegria
was perfect in both presentation and balance.
It looked just like a finished bouquet of flowers!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Mmm, perfection♪
It's dished up beautifully without falling apart~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Aw, you flatter me!
Alright, now all that's left is to eat it up♪
Where should I start eating from~~...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This balance... This is the balance!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: THIS is the balance~~~~!!

Gran Alegria dashed right out.
I chased after her all the way to the track, but—
watching her run made me realize something!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*...
I did it, I did iiit--!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Seeing how the salad is arranged, a lightbulb goes off in my head☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You gather up the wind as you run, and dash softly through it!
Yes, just like a salad!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Man, salads really teach us so many things, don't they~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I left my salad behind!
I have to go back and eat it~~~!?

And so, right after her major discovery (?), the ever-busy
Gran Alegria darted off toward the cafeteria once more.
